name: Ruby Modular
description: Dinamik modular uslub: ruby va indigo aksentlar, kuchli sarlavhalar va spotlight bloklar. Marketing, loyiha va kreativ brief uchun.
prompt_guidance: Create energetic but factual section titles that work well in modular marketing-style blocks.
Use insight-driven facts with examples, audience segments, campaign mechanics, or project milestones.
Prefer spotlight-style explanations over dense paragraphs.
Use tables only when they clarify segments, channels, priorities, or before-after comparisons.
Keep wording vivid, compact, and grounded in concrete details.
